entities.summary: Richard Allen Rellford is an American former professional basketball player. Born in Riviera Beach, Florida, he was a 6-foot-6-inch (1.98 m), 230-pound (100 kg) power forward. He played four games in the National Basketball Association (NBA), and three seasons in the Israeli Basketball Premier League.
